periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented at approximately 45 degrees relative to the mid-sagittal plane, sloping toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elliptical shape with a longitudinal axis approximately 1.6 times the vertical axis height.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward extension and tapering at the inferior-medial margin, creating a teardrop-like shift from the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a relatively straight horizontal profile across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 35 percent of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation on the cranial vault, with the ears positioned towards the outer edges of the crown.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex semi-circular curvature with slight flattening at the superior-most apex of the right pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant earth-toned staining and discoloration of the typically white pelage on the lateral flanks and posterior torso.
